lklynet/spider-solitaire
https://github.com/lklynet/spider-solitaire
commit d4478182a93da6b02ab9f590bb2f7409461077a4
MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Lee Kelly

One-suit Spider: eight 13-card runs, ten tableau piles, a stock that
deals one card onto each pile. Upstream is React + Zustand + Vite with
themes and a hint engine. This port destacks the engine (deck, moves,
replay) to classic scripts. The tableau is a private save. Tap a run,
tap where it goes.
